## Change and scientific scope

- Base SHA:
- Head SHA:
- Trust boundary affected:
- System/engine milestone impact:
- Explicit exclusions (e.g. frozen H3.9.2 qualification):

## Maintainer-first review (required before Codex)

- [ ] Inspected complete latest HEAD diff, contracts, algorithms, CLI, CI and docs
- [ ] Recorded invariants, abuse paths, failure modes and concrete findings
- [ ] Added reproduction/regression tests for material findings
- [ ] Verified no unintended changes outside agreed scope
- [ ] Captured exact latest-HEAD CI run and outcome
- Maintainer audit URL / artifact:

## Secondary review

- [ ] Requested Codex **after** completed maintainer review and successful latest-HEAD CI, OR
- [ ] Documented Codex quota/unavailability and performed explicitly non-independent maintainer-only fallback
- Codex review SHA / status / fallback reason:
- Unresolved findings and blocking risks:

## Merge gate

- [ ] HEAD unchanged since the completed review and CI; if changed, repeat relevant steps
- [ ] Tests and release constraints satisfied; no fabricated human signoffs
- [ ] Postmerge CI verification plan recorded
